title: GELF

fields.name: match
fields.description: Pattern to match which tags of logs to be outputted by this plugin

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target Graylog server

fields.name: port
fields.description: The port that your Graylog GELF input is listening on

fields.name: mode
fields.description: The protocol to use (tls, tcp or udp)

fields.name: gelf_tag_key
fields.description: Key to be used for tag.

fields.name: gelf_short_message_key
fields.description: A short descriptive message (MUST be set in GELF)

fields.name: gelf_timestamp_key
fields.description: Your log timestamp (SHOULD be set in GELF)

fields.name: gelf_host_key
fields.description: Key which its value is used as the name of the host, source or application that sent this message.

fields.name: gelf_full_message_key
fields.description: Key to use as the long message that can i.e.

fields.name: gelf_level_key
fields.description: Key to be used as the log level.

fields.name: packet_size
fields.description: If transport protocol is udp, you can set the size of packets to be sent.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: If transport protocol is udp, you can set this if you want your UDP packets to be compressed.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: GELF is Graylog Extended Log Format.
